Problem Statement: Creators struggle to consistently find content ideas.
Build Challenge: Build an app where topic + audience generates 10 relevant content ideas.

Problem Statement: One idea needs different treatment on every platform.
Build Challenge: Convert one content input into LinkedIn, Instagram, X and YouTube versions.

Problem Statement: Writing strong hooks takes too much time.
Build Challenge: Generate 10 hooks for a topic using different styles.

Problem Statement: Creators don't know what to post today.
Build Challenge: Use niche + goal to generate today's content plan.

Problem Statement: Short-form creators struggle to structure 30–60 second videos.
Build Challenge: Turn an idea into a hook, body and CTA.

Problem Statement: Long videos contain many reusable short clips.
Build Challenge: Analyze a transcript and identify the best short-form moments with timestamps.

Problem Statement: Creators need better thumbnail concepts.
Build Challenge: Turn a video title into visual concepts and thumbnail text.

Problem Statement: Creators waste time writing captions.
Build Challenge: Turn content or an image description into a platform-ready caption.

Problem Statement: Creators struggle with calls-to-action that don't sound repetitive.
Build Challenge: Generate contextual CTAs based on the creator's goal.

Problem Statement: Creators receive hundreds of comments but can't easily understand audience sentiment.
Build Challenge: Analyze comments into themes, questions, complaints and opportunities.

Problem Statement: Creators miss good ideas hidden inside audience comments.
Build Challenge: Convert audience comments into future post and video ideas.

Problem Statement: Research before creating educational content takes too long.
Build Challenge: Turn a topic into key facts, angles and useful sources.

Problem Statement: Creators don't maintain a consistent writing style.
Build Challenge: Learn from previous posts and create a new draft following the creator's style.

Problem Statement: Podcast creators spend too much time creating supporting content.
Build Challenge: Turn a transcript into a title, description, chapters and highlights.

Problem Statement: Creators struggle to organize scripts, drafts and published content.
Build Challenge: Build an Idea → Research → Script → Published workflow.

Problem Statement: Creators don't know which old content deserves to be reused.
Build Challenge: Analyze content history and recommend what to repost or rework.

Problem Statement: Brand collaborations require repetitive proposals and pitches.
Build Challenge: Use creator profile + brand information to generate a personalized collaboration proposal.

Problem Statement: Turning an idea into a complete production plan requires several disconnected steps.
Build Challenge: Research a topic, identify angles, recommend a narrative, generate a script, suggest visuals/B-roll, create a shot list and publishing copy.

Problem Statement: Creators can't easily search, reuse or connect everything they have produced.
Build Challenge: Store creator knowledge and enable semantic questions such as 'Have I talked about this before?' and 'What can become a reel?'

Problem Statement: Writers need AI assistance without losing character and story continuity.
Build Challenge: Build a workspace that understands characters, locations, scenes and previous context while assisting with dialogue, action and scene progression.

Problem Statement: Creators repeatedly transform one idea into many different content formats.
Build Challenge: Turn one idea through Research → YouTube Script → 3 Reels → LinkedIn Post → X Thread → Captions → Publishing Calendar.

Problem Statement: Creators need ongoing strategic decisions, not just individual generated posts.
Build Challenge: Given a creator goal, define audience, content pillars and a 30-day strategy, generate today's content, retain history and adapt recommendations using performance data.
